description: Permanently delete one or more folders and the files directly inside them. There is no undo. Subfolders are not deleted: the API moves them to the top level, so delete those too to remove a whole tree. The result counts the folders processed and deleted, files_deleted, and gives each folder a result. If the API answers that some files in a folder failed to delete (error ALL_FAILED), the folder is gone anyway and those files stay in the account: find them with list_files and remove them with delete_files.

identifiers.description: The folders to delete, with the files directly inside them

items.description: The folder identifier (the id field of list_folders)

name: delete_folders
title: Delete folders
